description: Na₃Zr₂Si₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.83 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.67 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.77 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.98 Å. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.25 Å. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.17 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-48°. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-42°. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-42°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-40°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom.
